Draw ONLY ONE LEFT HALF of an ornamental double garden gate scene, on clean white background, in natural lightly colored detailed textbook illustration, not monochrome and not a black silhouette. This exact left artwork will be reflected by the deterministic compositor to make the right half. Do not draw the second/right half.

Composition: far-left short narrow iron fence section with pointed upright pickets; one tall stone gatepost near the left third with decorative vase/leaf finial; then a single rectangular gate leaf toward the RIGHT edge of the illustration. The gate leaf has a rectangular recessed ornamental panel, small diamond/round central medallion, matching ornamental upper motif and curling iron scrollwork above. The inner edge at the RIGHT is the central seam when reflected. Gate leaf reaches that seam with no extra central post. All natural material details must be clear and plausible, iron blue-gray, stone light gray, restrained natural colors.

Keep the entire post finial and fence visible. Side view, frontal flat elevation with no perspective tilt, camera centered, straight baseline. Single half scene, balanced with open clean white margins. Do not include ground hatch, old-book scratches, Russian/Soviet insignia, flags, uniforms, logos or historical location.

Lesson: 图139画的是一座花园的大门. 两扇大门关于直线$l$对称. 如果作关于这条直线的对称图形，就可以得到相同的图形. 如果一个图形经过对称移动变成它自己，就说，**这个图形关于直线$l$对称.** 这时直线$l$叫做**图形的对称轴.** 对称轴把图形分成相互对称的两部分.

Lesson: 在自然界和技术中，经常可以看到轴对称图形(图140).某些图形有几个对称轴. 如正方形(图141)有四个对称轴. 过圆心的任意直线(图142)都是圆的对称轴.
